name: Adzap
description: Enter a world where every crazy idea shines! From glow-in-the-dark gadgets to products that make absolutely no sense, turn the most ridiculous invention into an advertisement everyone will remember. Think fast, act bold, and bring your brightest ideas to the stage. In this neon-powered battle of creativity, the wildest pitch takes the spotlight!
guidelines: Design a product/ad that's attractive, innovative, funny, and wildly imaginative.
Bring out your creativity through unique concepts, catchy dialogues, and energetic performances.
Make the advertisement engaging and entertaining for the audience.
Every team member should take part in the act.
Props are welcome — keep them simple and manageable.
Keep the humor clean and suitable for the audience.
Stick to the time limit, or risk losing points.
rules: Each team must consist of 4–6 members.
The product will be revealed only at the start of the event.
Teams will have 7 minutes to prepare their advertisement.
The performance must be completed within 4–5 minutes.
Offensive, vulgar, or inappropriate content is strictly prohibited.
The judges' decision will be final.

name: Debate
description: ”Argue. Convince. Win.” Step into the arena of ideas and put your wit, confidence, and communication skills to the test. Think on your feet, defend your stance, challenge opposing views, and adapt quickly as the debate takes unexpected turns. Get ready for a battle of brains, words, and perspectives!
guidelines: The debate will be conducted in two rounds.
opics will be provided on the spot for both rounds.
Round 1 will have individual participation, and the top 6 will advance to Round 2 as two teams of 3 members each.
Use of offensive, vulgar, or disrespectful content will lead to disqualification.
Reading directly from phones or papers is strictly prohibited.

rules.heading: Prelims
items: Block and Tackle
A random topic will be given on the spot
1 minute of preparation time.
1 minute to speak.
When prompted to TACKLE, speak in favor of the topic.
When prompted to BLOCK, speak against the topic.
You may be asked to switch multiple times during your speech.

rules.heading: Finals
items: Finalists will be grouped into teams.
The format will be explained during the finale.
Jury’s decision is final.

name: Drama
description:
Lights rise, the curtain opens, and the story begins. Step into a world where every expression speaks, every silence matters, and every character carries a story waiting to be heard. Transform into your role, command the stage, and leave the audience breathless. Your character. Your story. Your unforgettable moment awaits.
Theme: "Reincarnation"- The Infinite Soul Travel
guidelines: Script Submission: Submit a draft of your script online for the first-round evaluation.
Final Performance: Shortlisted teams will be notified via WhatsApp and will proceed to perform their script on stage on the event day.
The drama script should be mailed to 'brainstraindrama@gmail.com' on or before 8th Sept 2026
rules: Spot registrations will not be accepted. Only pre-registered teams are eligible to participate.
Each team must consist of 8–10 members. Teams not adhering to this requirement will not be permitted to participate.
Each team must complete the entire performance, including setup and clearance, within 20 minutes.
Exceeding the allotted time or violating any event rules may lead to disqualification.
Teams are responsible for arranging their own props and costumes. The use of hazardous materials is strictly prohibited.
The use of foul language, abusive, obscene, offensive, or inappropriate content is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification.
Participants must report on time and strictly adhere to the instructions provided by the organizers.
Participants and spectators are expected to maintain discipline, respect, and decorum throughout the event.
All performances must remain relevant to the given theme.
The decision of the judges will be final and binding.

name: JAM
description:
Want to test your imagination, creativity, and potential?
Then step into a world where one minute is all you get to make an impact!
Think beyond the ordinary, speak without limits, and let your ideas take the spotlight.
guidelines: Individual Participation
Two-round event
If any means of malpractice is noticed, the participant will be immediately disqualified.

rules.heading: Prelims
items: The prelims will follow an on-the-spot speaking format.
Participants will each be given a topic on which they have to speak for 1 minute.
A preparation time of 1 minute will be provided.
Use of the internet or mobile phones during the preparation time is strictly prohibited.
Shortlisted participants will be eligible for the Finals.

rules.heading: Finals
items: Further instructions will be provided on the spot.

name: Microtale
description: Embark on a literary journey of brevity and depth at our Microtale event! With just a few words, weave stories that linger in minds and hearts. Join us for poetic magic where the tiniest tales hold the mightiest power by unleashing your creativity and crafting miniature worlds where every letter counts.
guidelines: Individual participation only.
It is a single-round event.
Topics will be given on the spot.
rules: The topic will be given on the spot.
The contestant has to write a tale on the given topic in less than 40 words.
Plagiarism should be strictly avoided.
Entries with vulgarity, profanity, or offensive/inappropriate content will be disqualified.
Each person is allowed to submit only one entry.
Time limit: 7 minutes.

name: Poem
description: Let your words dance with emotions and paint vivid pictures through poetry! This event is a stage for your imagination, where creativity meets expression, and every verse tells a story straight from the heart.
guidelines: Individual participation.
It is a single-round event.
Participants should carry a pen for the event.
15 minutes will be provided for composing the poem.
rules: The poem should have a minimum of 8 lines and should not exceed 16 lines.
Strictly avoid plagiarism.
Poems containing vulgarity, profanity, or offensive/inappropriate content will not be considered for evaluation.
A person is allowed to submit a maximum of 1 entry only.
Usage of ChatGPT or any AI tool will result in immediate disqualification.

name: Puzzle
description: Put your logic and creativity to the ultimate test at our Puzzle event! Challenge yourself with a series of intriguing riddles, clever brainteasers, and thought-provoking puzzles designed to test your reasoning and problem-solving skills. Work together, think beyond the obvious, and uncover the answers hidden within each challenge. Are you ready to put your mind to the test?
guidelines: Two members per team.
This is a single-round event.
rules: Duration: 30 minutes.
The use of mobile phones or digital aids is not allowed.
Cheating or malpractice is strictly prohibited.
The Jury's decision is final.

name: Quiz
description:
A battle of brains and speed, where knowledge is your only weapon
and wit is your shield. From facts to challenges, every question is a
wave to ride or a storm to survive. Team up, think sharp, and prove
you have what it takes to outsmart the rest. The quest for the ultimate
quiz champion begins here!
guidelines: Each team should consist of 2 members
Two Round Event
Vulgar, offensive, or inappropriate content is strictly prohibited.
The captain’s decision will be final.

rules.heading: Prelims
items: Using mobile phones during the event will lead to immediate disqualification.
Preliminary rounds will be conducted strictly within the given time frame.
Only the top six teams will qualify for the finals.

rules.heading: Finals
items: Rules for the final round will be announced on the spot.

name: Shipwreck
description:
As the ship slips beneath the waves, one question remains — who deserves to survive?

When survival comes down to a single choice, what would you say to make the captain choose you?

Become your character, unleash your wit, and fight for the last life jacket.
guidelines: Individual participation only.
Stay in character and make your performance convincing.
Participants may showcase any talent of their choice.
Participants must bring their own props and required materials.
Each participant must strictly adhere to the 60-second time limit.
Vulgarity, offensive content, or inappropriate performances are strictly prohibited.
If karaoke or background audio/video is required, participants must submit it through the designated link before the event.
Participants shortlisted in the Prelims will advance to the Finals.

rules.heading: Prelims
items: A hypothetical scenario will be given on the spot.
Participants requiring karaoke/background audio or video must submit the required file through the designated link before the commencement of the event.
Each participant must speak for 1 minute 30 seconds
The Top 6 participants will receive a premium ticket to sail in the Cruise (Finals)
Participants who are shortlisted will advance to the Finals.

rules.heading: Finals
items: All rules applicable to the Prelims shall also be followed in the Finals.
Each finalist will be assigned a random character on the spot.
Be the character, think like them, act like them and breathe life into them.
The goal is to convince the captain why YOU deserve the life jacket
Further instructions will be provided on the spot

name: Uno Minuto
description: Step into the spotlight and showcase your unique talent in just 60 seconds. From singing and dancing to mimicry, storytelling, or any creative skill, make every second count and leave the audience amazed.
guidelines: Individual participation only.
The event will be conducted in two rounds – Prelims and Finals.
Participants may showcase any talent of their choice.
Participants must bring their own props and required materials.
Each participant must strictly adhere to the 60-second time limit.
Vulgarity, offensive content, or inappropriate performances are strictly prohibited.
If karaoke or background audio/video is required, participants must submit it through the designated link before the event.

rules.heading: Prelims
items: Participants shall showcase a talent of any kind while avoiding vulgarity and offensive content.
Participants are responsible for bringing their own props, if required.
Each participant must complete their performance within 60 seconds.
Participants who are shortlisted will advance to the Finals.

rules.heading: Finals
items: All rules applicable to the Prelims shall also be followed in the Finals.
Participants may perform the same skill or a different skill from the Prelims.
If the same skill is performed, the content and method of delivery must be different from the Prelims.
Participants showcasing a different skill in the Finals will be eligible for bonus points.
In case of a tie, the audience will vote through a poll to determine the best performer.
The decision of the judges will be final, subject to the event rules.
